import csv, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
root=Path('test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933')
folder=root/'verification/mistral7b_full_e2e_score_integrity_20260929_0249'
source=folder/'verified_e2e_summary.csv'; pairs=folder/'verified_e2e_comparison.csv'
before={str(path):hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in (source,pairs)}
rows=list(csv.DictReader(source.open())); records=list(csv.DictReader(pairs.open()))
cases=['latency_128x64_r1','latency_256x128_r1','service_1024x256_r4','saturation_1024x256_inf','saturation_1536x384_inf']
labels=['128/64 @1','256/128 @1','1024/256 @4','1024/256 burst','1536/384 burst']
selected={row['value'].split(':')[0]:row for row in rows if row['group']=='case_metric' and row['value'].endswith(':mean_e2e_latency_ms')}
assert set(selected)==set(cases)
assert all(int(row['n'])==5 for row in selected.values())
filename=folder/'mistral_e2e_actual_vs_ml.png'
assert not filename.exists()
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.6)); x=np.arange(5); w=.35
for index,(prefix,label,color) in enumerate((('real','Real A100 PCIe','#3d7ca6'),('predicted','ML simulator','#d28d3b'))):
    values=np.array([float(selected[case][f'{prefix}_mean'])/1000 for case in cases])
    deviations=np.array([float(selected[case][f'{prefix}_std'])/1000 for case in cases])
    bars=axes[0].bar(x+(index-.5)*w,values,w,yerr=deviations,capsize=3,label=label,color=color)
    axes[0].bar_label(bars,fmt='%.2f',padding=4,fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Mean request E2E (s)'); axes[0].set_title('Actual vs predicted: mean and SD across five groups')
axes[0].set_xticks(x,labels,rotation=25,ha='right'); axes[0].legend(); axes[0].grid(axis='y',alpha=.2)
for index,case in enumerate(cases):
    points=[float(row['absolute_percentage_error_pct']) for row in records if row['case']==case and row['metric']=='mean_e2e_latency_ms']
    assert len(points)==5
    axes[1].scatter(np.full(5,index)+np.linspace(-.09,.09,5),points,s=28,color='#667c94',label='Five paired group means' if index==0 else None)
    mean=float(selected[case]['mape_pct'])
    axes[1].plot([index-.18,index+.18],[mean,mean],color='#a54d41',linewidth=3,label='Mean paired APE' if index==0 else None)
    axes[1].annotate(f'{mean:.2f}%',(index,mean),xytext=(0,7),textcoords='offset points',ha='center',fontsize=8)
axes[1].set_ylim(0,27); axes[1].set_ylabel('APE of group-mean E2E (%)'); axes[1].set_title('Each point is one real/replay pair, not one request')
axes[1].set_xticks(x,labels,rotation=25,ha='right'); axes[1].legend(fontsize=8); axes[1].grid(axis='y',alpha=.2)
fig.suptitle('Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2: five independent request groups per workload')
fig.text(.5,.015,'Length labels are nominal sampling bounds. Groups use different requests; SD is not isolated hardware jitter.',ha='center',fontsize=9)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0,.05,1,.94)); fig.savefig(filename,dpi=180); plt.close(fig)
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==value for path,value in before.items())
(folder/'figure_source_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_sha256':before,'figure':str(filename),'figure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(filename.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'paired_cases':25,'requests':1280,'no_fit_gpu_or_metric_correction':True},indent=2)+'\n')
print(filename)
